target.name: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. II

listed_quote.quote: announced today that it intends to list the Company’s shares of common stock on the New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”).

announcement.quote: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. (“OTF”) and Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. II (“OTF II”) today announced that they have entered into a definitive merger agreement, with OTF as the surviving company

outcome_evidence.quote: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. (“OTF”) today announced the closing of its merger with Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. II (“OTF II”), with OTF as the surviving company.

deals.notes: Merger completed 2025-03-24 (shareholder approvals 2025-03-20), but OTF only announced an intention to list on the NYSE on 2025-06-03 (after closing), so it was not exchange-listed at the time of the deal; no excerpt shows OTF II as listed either. outcome_evidence shows the merger completed; outcome is not_a_listed_pair because both_listed is false.
